messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] p99 latency for route `chat.completions` > 5.0s over 5m (route=chat.completions). Affected models: m3-small, gpt-3a-compat. Pager: oncall-eng. :rotating_light:

mira: got the page, jumping in. first pass: p95 up but p99 spike is bigger for m3-small. checking dashboards and KV cache hit rates now.

alex: I'm by my laptop, can help with quick alert config changes if we want to squelch noise. what's the impact on customers?

jorge: I see increased queueing on the small pool in eu-west-1, autoscale isn't catching up for short bursts. maybe batching combos are spiking.

mira: customer impact: CS reported a single customer with timed-out sessions (~8 sessions) but no increase in 5xx. mostly slow responses 10-30s. filing a CS thread: <#customer-success> pinging @cs-bot to track.

cs-bot: Created customer thread CUST-2387 and notified account lead.

rachel: quick thought — we should avoid suppressing p95 alerts globally. propose per-route p99 temporary squelch and create a per-model p99 panel for investigation.

alex: agree. propose changes:
1) Add a 10m squelch on INF-ALERT-8732 for route=chat.completions, model=m3-small (squelch only, still log events).
2) Create new dashboard tiles: p95/p99 by model and by route over 5m/1h windows.
3) Add fallback routing rule to route to gpt-3a-compat if m3-small p99 > 7s for 2 consecutive windows.

mira: can you sketch the alert query we will use? want to avoid noisy bucketing.

alex: sample PromQL to use in the new alert (rough):
```
# p99 latency per model for route chat.completions over 5m
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="chat.completions"}[5m])) by (le, model))
```
set threshold per-model via label `model=~"m3-small|gpt-3a-compat"`.

jorge: for squelch we should target when p99 delta > 1.5s relative to baseline and only if p95 < 2s, that indicates tail noise, not broad slowdown.

mira: +1. Also add an alert annotation to link to a replay job for affected traces so SRE can quickly replay offending requests.

alert-bot: Noted. Drafting change: policy `INF-ALERT-8732` will have a temporary suppression rule (10m) scoped to `route=chat.completions, model=m3-small`. Change requires terraform PR and owner approval.

alex: I'll open the PR now with the change and the new dashboard JSON. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1129 (WIP).

mira: handing off to jorge for overnight watch at 02:30Z — jorge you're the responder for the next 6h.

jorge: taking over. plan: watch p99 for m3-small and gpt-3a-compat, check KV cache hit% and batching size distribution. if p99 > 7s persist for 3 windows, flip fallback routing.

rachel: action items for post-incident:
- (SRE) finalize per-model p99 panels and alert scoping (owner: alex)
- (Infra) add squelch playbook entry and automation for temporary suppress (owner: mira)
- (Product) evaluate customer UX impact & follow up (owner: rachel)
- (CS) notify affected accounts and log mitigation steps (owner: cs-bot)

mira: timeline: aim to push squelch + dashboard change in next 30m, monitor for 2h, then revert squelch or convert to tuned threshold based on evidence.

alex: pushed initial PR with squelch rule and dashboard tile drafts. CI checks - linting passed, waiting on approvals.

jorge: monitoring now. kv_cache_hit for m3-small dropped from 92% -> 74% during spike; batching skew looks higher (more single-request batches). looks like traffic pattern changed. continuing watch.

mira: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene for a short postmortem tomorrow morning 09:00 PT if things don't settle. adding notes to incident board. :memo:

incident-bot: ALERT resolved: p99 back below 3.0s for route `chat.completions` (5m window). auto-close will run in 15m unless new alerts fire.

alex: marking PR ready for review and adding test cases for route-scoped squelch.

jorge: final note: no customer-facing 5xx increase, mitigations kept service available. follow-up: consider soft-limits on batching to avoid queueing spikes.

mira: handoff complete, closing thread from oncall perspective.
